Elsewhere, relegation-threatened Tottenham Hotspur travel to high-flying Aston Villa whilst Bournemouth, another team hoping to secure European football next season, take on Crystal Palace. Kelly Cates presents.

channel.title: The Titfield Thunderbolt
channel.desc: The village of Titfield's single-track railway link to Mallingford is closed down because it is losing money. The villagers, roused by train enthusiast Weech, plan to run the line independently with a rich eccentric Valentine providing the money, but their action arouses the opposition of the local bus company, run by Pearce and Vernon Crump, who attempt various acts of sabotage when the new line is opened.

channel.title: Whisky Galore!
channel.desc: Classic Ealing comedy about a scotch-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. However, it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo.
